description: Hypothetical routing queries for Skill activation. expected_skills lists every Skill that should load; cycle loads for a new or resumed objective and multi-phase coordination; a request limited to one phase loads that phase Skill alone, while a request that also asks for a later phase is an objective (finding a cause before fixing loads cycle; research before a plan the user has not requested stays phase-only); task-authoring is not a phase and loads alone for ticket wording; routine claims and closures load cycle only. near_miss_for lists neighbouring Skills that should NOT load. Evaluation input only, not results. Starter size: 2-4 positives per phase Skill, below the 8-10 recommended; results are directional until expanded.
run: Requires explicit authorization for a model/host campaign. Confirm the installed creator CLI with --help first. On Goose 1.57, skill-creator trigger-eval watches for a load_skill call, but Goose emits load with a source argument, so every run reads as not-triggered; it also sees any installed copy of this plugin. Until that is fixed, use a multi-Skill harness: isolate the host config (no installed copy of this plugin), place a frozen snapshot of skills/ in the run workspace, run each query 3 times and record every load call. An empty workspace only shows first-hop routing; chained loads such as cycle then research need a fixture repository and tracker. Evaluate all Skills on the same near misses.
